integrity: Exact symbolic adjoint and twisted-spectrum identities were replayed with the enclosed verifier; direct Liouvillian and spectrum checks provide finite corroboration. Prior published equivalents outside inspected material remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for an open, compact-point, two-mode Kitaev Hamiltonian, local sitewise-balanced loss and gain with possibly unequal rates, and Fock product initial states; finite-time one-site and twisted fermionic-negativity spectral crossings, not generic entanglement lifetime.
title: Contrast-driven entanglement clocks in a sitewise-balanced dissipative Kitaev dimer
